classifications.rationale: The President reports to Congress that a separate executive order was issued and summarizes its legal effects and delegated implementation authority; this segment does not itself impose those effects.
classifications.evidence: I hereby report I have issued an Executive Order

classifications.rationale: The President describes the separate order’s entry suspension and transmits a copy to Congress; the segment itself is a report and enclosure communication.
classifications.evidence: I am enclosing a copy of the order I have issued.
